study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Use normative modeling of task-fMRI activation during an emotional episodic memory task to quantify individualized deviations in MDD, BD, and SZ; embed deviations in large-scale emotional networks and relate them to affective symptoms and cell-type signatures via imaging transcriptomics.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Multiple linear regression predicting affective symptoms; nested LOOCV; performance by Pearson r and RMSE; significance via permutation test (p_perm < .05).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Distinct, diagnosis-specific deviation patterns in emotional networks predict affective symptoms; cell-type enrichment implicates microglia (MDD), astrocytes (BD), and excitatory neurons (SZ).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Individualized deviations during emotional memory retrieval show non-overlapping network-level abnormalities across MDD, BD, and SZ. Deviations embedded in EN3 (emotion perception/generation) and other ENs relate to symptom severity. Imaging transcriptomics link macroscale deviations to cell-type signatures: microglia (MDD), astrocytes (BD), excitatory neurons (SZ), with significant associations between individual-level NES and affective symptoms.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Relatively small clinical sample sizes; non-overlapping affective measures across diagnoses (missing BD item scores); BD cohort mostly euthymic; possible residual medication confounds; AHBA gene data limited (n=6 donors; left hemisphere only); indirect linkage between imaging and transcriptomics without within-subject data.
caa10_key_limitations.supporting_text: "First, the clinical sample size was relatively small ... Second, non-overlapping measures for affective symptoms ... data on depressive severity in patients with BD were partially missing ... Third, most patients with BD ... euthymic ... Fourth, ... medication ... cannot be entirely ruled out ... Fifth, gene expression data from the AHBA were obtained from 6 healthy donors ... left hemisphere ... Finally, ... relationship being inferred indirectly ... within-subject designs ..."

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Task-fMRI normative modeling applied to transdiagnostic cohorts; deviations summarized at regional/network/circuit levels; external validation on independent HC cohort; no explicit site harmonization applied.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Acquisition on 3T GE Discovery MR750 at two centers; preprocessing in SPM12 with DK atlas (68 cortical + 14 subcortical). Normative model trained on HCtrain (n=409) using behavioral predictors (RT encoding/retrieval; ACC retrieval); validated via 10-fold CV (SMSE≈1, MSLL≈0) and external HCtest. Extreme deviations at |z|≥2.6; results robust to atlas choice and age/sex inclusion; medication effects examined (no significant correlations).
